#!/bin/bash
set -u

STATE=/var/lib/etc-integrity
BASELINE=$STATE/baseline.tsv
LOGDIR=/var/log/etc-integrity

manifest() {
    find /etc -xdev -print0 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
        if [ ! -e "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        rel=${path#/etc}
        [ -n "$rel" ] || rel=/
        mode=$(stat -c %a -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        uid=$(stat -c %u -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        gid=$(stat -c %g -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        size=$(stat -c %s -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        if [ -L "$path" ]; then
            kind=link
            target=$(readlink -- "$path" 2>/dev/null)
            digest=$(printf '%s' "$target" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
        elif [ -f "$path" ]; then
            kind=file
            digest=$(sha256sum -- "$path" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
            [ -n "$digest" ] || digest=UNREADABLE
        elif [ -d "$path" ]; then
            kind=dir
            digest=-
        elif [ -b "$path" ]; then
            kind=block
            digest=-
        elif [ -c "$path" ]; then
            kind=char
            digest=-
        elif [ -p "$path" ]; then
            kind=fifo
            digest=-
        elif [ -S "$path" ]; then
            kind=socket
            digest=-
        else
            kind=other
            digest=-
        fi
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$rel" "$kind" "$mode" "$uid" "$gid" "$size" "$digest"
    done
}

initialize() {
    tmp=$(mktemp "$STATE/baseline.XXXXXX") || exit 2
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    manifest > "$tmp" || exit 2
    chown root:root "$tmp"
    chmod 600 "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" "$BASELINE"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    printf 'Baseline initialized: %s entries at %s\n' "$(wc -l < "$BASELINE")" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}

check() {
    if [ ! -r "$BASELINE" ]; then
        printf 'ERROR: baseline missing: %s\n' "$BASELINE" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    current=$(mktemp "$STATE/current.XXXXXX") || exit 2
    report=$(mktemp "$STATE/report.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$current"; exit 2; }
    trap 'rm -f "$current" "$report"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    manifest > "$current" || exit 2
    awk -F '\t' '
        NR == FNR { old[$1]=$0; next }
        {
            seen[$1]=1
            if (!($1 in old)) {
                print "ADDED\t" $1
                print "  CURRENT\t" $0
            } else if ($0 != old[$1]) {
                print "CHANGED\t" $1
                print "  BASELINE\t" old[$1]
                print "  CURRENT\t" $0
            }
        }
        END {
            for (path in old) {
                if (!(path in seen)) {
                    print "REMOVED\t" path
                    print "  BASELINE\t" old[path]
                }
            }
        }
    ' "$BASELINE" "$current" > "$report"
    if [ -s "$report" ]; then
        log="$LOGDIR/changes-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).log"
        { printf 'Integrity differences detected at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; cat "$report"; } | tee "$log"
        chmod 600 "$log"
        exit 1
    fi
    printf 'Integrity check OK: /etc matches %s (%s entries)\n' "$BASELINE" "$(wc -l < "$BASELINE")"
}

case "${1:-}" in
    --init) initialize ;;
    --check) check ;;
    *) printf 'Usage: %s --init|--check\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
